records.c: First 256 bytes of the unpacked M1 map resource. In the naturally reached closed-gate snapshot, cells zero through three are $01,$03,$01,$01; the shared classifier uses these for the first four 64-unit horizontal columns. The selected gate example covers world X zero through 255. Other map consumers and rows remain open.

Start of the 32-byte scene header that the loader at $557A unpacks after the map. The bytes are $50 31 2D 2D 00 00 00 00 0C 0B 0A 0A 0A 0A 55 31. The loader reads $0701 ($31, "1") as the name character of the picture P and character set C resources it loads to $BC00 and $E000, $070F ($31, "1") as the name character of the overlay U loaded to $8B00, and $0703 ($2D, "-") as the extra costume selector, where a dash means none; the costume at $A000 is therefore not loaded by this header. $0700 and $0702 are not read by the loader.

Three numeric header bytes, all 0 here: $0704 is the loop limit the loader compares at $568F and is read by the camera and motion routines, $0705 indexes the tables at $59A1 and $59A8 that set $5E, $5F and $60, and from $566A $0706 is shifted right twice into $02C8, its low two bits going to bits 7-6 of $02C7.

Seven colour bytes ($0707-$070D = 00 0C 0B 0A 0A 0A 0A) read by $5A34: $0708 and $0709 go to the VIC background colour registers $D022 and $D023, $0707 is cached at $02DD as the display colour, and $070A-$070D are copied to the four message palette bytes $6998-$699B unless $0387 and $26 are both negative ($5A46-$5A4D then skip to $5A6D).
Two bytes, "U1" ($55 $31): the overlay resource name, whose second character the loader compares with its cache at $508E and loads at $8B00 ($070F).

Ten bytes ($0710-$0719 = 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 FD 2C): depth thresholds. The table is read indexed from $0710 by the object grid and placement routines at $28CA, $37B9 (in $37B4), $383F, $3863 and $5487, $0711 at $548A, $0718 at $5397 and $0719 at $53B9. Eight are zero here; $0718 holds $FD and $0719 holds $2C, the only non-zero thresholds in this room.

Costume selector ($0B), read at $51EA and copied to $02C5 (replaced by 4 when $0385 is non-negative and $0565 is negative); the initial-animation table at $5985 is read at $520D. The three bytes after it ($071B-$071D = FF 01 FF) are read at $5201, $5207 and $51E4 when entry placement starts.

Sixteen replacement cell nibbles for OPEN, indexed by the current cell's low nibble. Bytes: 02 01 03 03 04 05 06 07 08 09 0A 0B 0C 0D 0E 0F. Nibble 0 becomes 2 and nibble 2 becomes 3; the others map to themselves.

Sixteen replacement cell nibbles for CLOSE, indexed by the current cell's low nibble. Bytes: 00 01 00 02 04 05 06 07 08 09 0A 0B 0C 0D 0E 0F. Nibble 2 becomes 0 and nibble 3 becomes 2; the others map to themselves, the reverse of gate_open_replacements for those two.

Sixteen low-nibble-to-type entries read indexed by the resident at $351E, $3565, $3B5A (in $3B51), $4192 (in $4173), $4A8E, $4B27, $4F7D, $4F99, $4FE8 and $503E; the gate overlay writes entries 0 and 2 at $8DA2/$8DA5. Bytes: 02 00 02 0E 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00. Initially entry 1 maps to type 0 and entry 3 to type 14; the gate script rewrites entries as it opens the approach. Entries 4 to 15 are zero (type 0).

Sixteen inclusive upper column bounds (all $FF). Resident $411C compares only entries 0 to 14 ($074E-$075C) and takes the first whose bound is at least the coarse column; if none is, the loop ends with region 15 without reading entry 15. With all $FF here every column selects region 0.

Sixteen zero bytes ($075E-$076D) between the column thresholds and the selectors. The scan at $411C reads at most index 14 ($075C), so it reads none of them; the resident routine $38FE (update_grid_special_cell) reads and writes $075E,Y (at $3901/$3915), and $381C increments $075E,X, with Y the low nibble of a special map cell, so any scene whose map has such cells uses these bytes as per-cell state.
Sixteen source selectors, one per region, all zero: selector 0 uses the region itself as the table index (bank 0), so only bank 0 of the exit arrays is ever read.
Scene requests of bank 0, one per region ($077E-$078D): region 0 requests scene 2; the rest are zero. A request of 0 keeps the current scene.
Entry identifiers of bank 0, one per region ($078E-$079D): 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 01. Every region holds entry $01.
Scene requests of bank 1, one per region ($079E-$07AD): all zero. A request of 0 keeps the current scene.
